from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from shopkit.orders.models import Order
from shopkit.shipping.packaging import format_weight
from shopkit.utils.collections import chunked, group_by


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Parcel:
    order_id: str
    number: int
    items: list[tuple[str, int]] = field(default_factory=list)
    gift_message: str = ""


def split_into_parcels(order: Order, lines_per_parcel: int = 25) -> list[Parcel]:
    """Split an order's lines into parcels of at most `lines_per_parcel` lines.

    The gift message travels with the first parcel only, so it is printed on a
    single packing slip rather than one per parcel.
    """
    items = [(line.sku, line.qty) for line in order.lines]
    return [
        Parcel(order.id, number, list(chunk), order.gift_message if number == 1 else "")
        for number, chunk in enumerate(chunked(items, lines_per_parcel), 1)
    ]


def packing_slip(parcel: Parcel, weight_g: int) -> str:
    """Slip packed inside each parcel: order, parcel number, contents and weight,
    plus the gift message on the first parcel."""
    lines = [f"Order {parcel.order_id} - parcel {parcel.number}", f"Weight: {format_weight(weight_g)}"]
    gift = " ".join(parcel.gift_message.split())
    if gift:
        lines.append(f"Gift message: {gift}")
    lines += [f"  {qty} x {sku}" for sku, qty in parcel.items]
    return "\n".join(lines)
